recognitionRules: Use Baskerville for the central proposition and Avenir for evidence and navigation.
Keep the five-frame sequence explicit in page labels.
Use dark teal, warm paper and a restrained gold marker.
Give each frame one focal statement, one supporting element and a visible qualification.

quote: One proposition. Five frames. Enough evidence to begin a conversation.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use FIVE FRAMES in Avenir beside five short aligned ticks, with only the current frame emphasized in applications. The mark itself stays neutral.
invariants: Use Baskerville for the central proposition and Avenir for evidence and navigation.
Keep the five-frame sequence explicit in page labels.
Use dark teal, warm paper and a restrained gold marker.
adaptations: A mobile sequence can use five stacked sections.
A one-page overview keeps the numbered order and short propositions.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
